In ref.reference, `versions` is a list of (starts,hops) tuples; I did `for starts,q,t in zip(versions,qtables,ttables)` → starts is the tuple (starts,hops). Fix: `for (sstarts, hh), q, t in ...` and use sstarts.

Let me patch ref.py.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
s=open('tmp/ref.py').read()
s=s.replace("    for starts,q,t in zip(versions,qtables,ttables):\n        R=len(starts)",
            "    for pair,q,t in zip(versions,qtables,ttables):\n        starts=list(pair[0]); R=len(starts)")
open('tmp/ref.py','w').write(s)
PY
python3 tmp/goldrun.py examples/compact.in.json && python3 tmp/goldrun.py examples/fullwidth.in.json
